James also got a mark in the triple jump where Farel Mepandy bettered 15m to gain a fine second spot in the A event. Meanwhile Mark Allen and Chris Gearing redressed the balance with good points in the shot when a drop to fourth team spot appeared a possibility.
Things were looking good in the triple jump with Farel Mepandy second in the A and David Wellstead, back from University in the USA, taking a valuable second spot in the B event.

The triple jump had been delayed by 45 minutes by the women’s competition; this was unfortunate as Farel Mepandy had to catch the 5.00pm local train in order to get to a Scunthorpe for a wedding the next day.
